destination.publisher_rules: PENDING VERIFICATION against the live C&S Guide for Authors; screened only against the skill's dated Elsevier snapshot

outputs.format: PDF (vector, Type 42 / CID TrueType Arial, opaque white, RGB)

transformations: analysis/analyze.py -> analysis/outputs/stats.json (Wilson CIs; Mantel-Haenszel risk difference with Sato variance; the crude Newcombe difference)

fig3/scripts/derive_fig3.py -> fig3/derived_numbers.json (per-product strata with each share's Wilson CI, MH weights and Newcombe differences; it also keeps the timing blocks of the removed panel c for provenance)

fig3/scripts/make_fig3_panels.py (drawing only, fs.v7_context(), each panel linted by sp_lint.lint_fig; the panels print the axis ticks and the registered threshold of a's grey note; every drawn value -- marks, CI ends, band ends, the grey threshold -- registered as a mark in panels/fig3_numbers.csv and checked by scripts/trace_fig3.py)
fig3/scripts/make_caption_fig3.py (the caption carries every count, the undrawn products' too; registry caption_fig3_numbers.csv)
uncertainty: a left, b: Wilson 95% CIs of a share (stores are the unit), drawn in the colour of their mark; a right: Newcombe 95% CI of the crude difference and the Mantel-Haenszel difference pooled over the consent products with Sato variance (strata = consent products). No bootstrap (no seed needed).
missing_data: 7 banner stores without a readable region default are excluded (caption). Consent products with fewer than 5 stores under either default are not drawn in a left; they enter the pooled difference (a right) and their counts are listed in the caption. Groups of fewer than design.min_stores_row stores are drawn grey and listed in the caption. Nothing lies outside an axis.
note: No automated report here certifies accessibility or journal compliance (skill guardrail).
